records.prompt:
Create an ORIGINAL game sprite asset sheet extending the visual language of the attached reference. Very strict RETRO LINES minimalist 16x16-inspired pixel-outline art. One-pixel glowing angular olive/amber/cyan outlines, almost black transparent interiors, very sparse pixels, no painterly gradients, no solid lush illustrations.
Output a very wide transparent canvas, arranged as exactly FOUR EQUAL WIDTH CELLS IN ONE HORIZONTAL ROW, each object fully isolated with at least 12% transparent margin around its own cell. No labels, text, numbers, UI, ground plane, drop shadows or background. Same baseline near bottom for all objects. Cell 1: a whole crooked OLD WINDCHIME TREE, short twisted trunk anchored with visible roots, windswept asymmetrical canopy, exactly three small brass bells suspended from its branches; whole tree complete, visible trunk and roots. Cell 2: a complete slender meadow BELL WINDMILL shrine, grounded old wooden base, small four-blade wind rotor and two hanging bell chimes, pleasing asymmetric fairy tale silhouette, not a castle. Cell 3: a small cluster of meadow GRASS, TINY FLOWERS and one weathered brass bell half embedded, small complete rooted object. Cell 4: an adorable tiny HOODED COURIER player character full body side view facing right, cream face visible in hood, rust red scarf streaming left, brown boots, clearly separate legs, no weapon. These are game assets for Windchime Plains in The Disordered Clock, a gentle but melancholy fairy tale. Keep each object narrow and vertical, don't join objects or draw terrain. These must look like designed reusable game sprites at small scale; faithfully maintain the supplied reference's markmaking and shape economy.
